doc.text:
Class for functions that talk to a lower level than haxe, such as message boxes, and more.
Some functions might not have effect on some platforms.

fields.name: registerAsDPICompatible
allocConsole

doc.text: Allocates a new console. The console will automatically be opened

fields.name: getFileAttributesRaw

doc.text: Gets the specified file's (or folder) attributes.

fields.name: getFileAttributes

doc.text: Gets the specified file's (or folder) attributes and passes it to `FileAttributeWrapper`.

fields.name: setFileAttributes

doc.text: Sets the specified file's (or folder) attributes. If it fails, the return value is `0`.

fields.name: addFileAttributes

doc.text: Removes from the specified file's (or folder) one (or more) specific attribute.

fields.name: removeFileAttributes

doc.text: Removes from the specified file's (or folder) one (or more) specific attribute.

fields.name: setDarkMode

doc.text: Switch the window's color mode to dark or light mode.

fields.name: setWindowBorderColor

doc.text:
Switch the window's color to any color.

WARNING: This is exclusive to windows 11 users, unfortunately.

NOTE: Setting the color to 0x00000000 (FlxColor.TRANSPARENT) will set the border (must have setBorder on) invisible.

fields.name: resetWindowBorderColor

doc.text:
Resets the window's border color to the default one.

WARNING: This is exclusive to windows 11 users, unfortunately.

fields.name: setWindowTitleColor

doc.text:
Switch the window's title text to any color.

WARNING: This is exclusive to windows 11 users, unfortunately.

fields.name: resetWindowTitleColor

doc.text:
Resets the window's title color to the default one.

WARNING: This is exclusive to windows 11 users, unfortunately.

fields.name: redrawWindowHeader

doc.text: Forces the window header to redraw, causes a small visual jitter so use it sparingly.
Can be used to check if your using a specific version of an OS (or if your using a certain OS).
